Inspection occurs before transmission, not merely after processing. Policies
fail closed for:

- AI transmission;
- full-text indexing;
- public sharing;
- exports;
- logs and traces;
- local drafts;
- backups;
- analytics; and
- third-party contact data.

The following matrix is normative. A career pack may make a rule stricter but
cannot relax it.

| Privacy class | Typical content | Remote AI | Account search/index | Logs/traces | Public share | Export/local draft/backup |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Private, the default | profile facts, opportunities, actions, ordinary practice | Per-request consent after payload preview | Allowed inside the owning account | Metadata and opaque IDs only | Only through a separately reviewed Share Projection | Account export allowed; account-namespaced local draft allowed; encrypted backup allowed |
| Sensitive | compensation, immigration, accommodation, private feedback, protected demographics | Off by default; separate field-level confirmation for one invocation | Off by default or masked; explicit opt-in | No field values or reversible identifiers | Excluded by default; separate confirmation and scoped snapshot required | Protected export only; encrypted local draft and backup |
| Third-party personal | recruiter/interviewer/contact identity, messages, notes about another person | Off by default; purpose-specific confirmation | Account-local only | Minimized pseudonymous IDs | Excluded unless that exact field is intentionally published | Included in full account export with warning; encrypted local draft and backup |
| Secret | provider credentials, reset/session tokens, share bearer material, encryption keys | Never | Never | Never | Never | Excluded from normal export and browser storage; only explicit rewrapped secret export; encrypted backup with separate key custody |
| Share Projection | owner-reviewed fields from one immutable Artifact Revision | Never as part of resolution | Not added to public indexing | Aggregate view event only when enabled | Allowed only through its scoped capability | Exportable immutable bytes; no browser draft; encrypted backup of owner record |

Normative lifecycle defaults and override bounds:

| Data category | Default | User/operator override | Purge and recovery rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Canonical entities, accepted revisions, and immutable attempts | Retain until explicit delete or account deletion | User may delete subject to disclosed artifact/history dependencies | Live authority and projections purge within 24 hours; minimized provenance tombstone may remain for 90 days |
| Raw Source Documents | 365 days after the last accepted derived change | 30, 90, or 365 days, or explicitly pinned indefinite; Sensitive/Third-party sources require renewed confirmation every 365 days | Content and derived search text purge within 24 hours after expiry; claims retain a content-redacted provenance tombstone |
| Uncommitted Capture Inbox sources | 30 days after last activity | 7, 30, or 90 days; explicit archive moves the source to the Source Document policy | Purge within 24 hours; a warning begins seven days before expiry |
| Failed parser/OCR/model intermediate files | 7 days | 0 or 7 days; no indefinite option | Purge within 24 hours while retaining failure class and digests |
| Provider Invocation protected payload snapshot | 7 days | 0, 1, 7, or 30 days; Secret data is never stored | Digest/receipt metadata may remain 365 days; protected plaintext purges within 24 hours of deadline |
| Normalized Staged Provider Result | 30 days after idempotent claim/proposal creation; retain while reconciliation is unresolved | 7, 30, or 90 days; Sensitive/Third-party result maximum 30 days | Encrypted and account-scoped; purge within 24 hours after deadline once deterministic application proof exists |
| Operational logs and traces | 14 days | Operator may choose 1–30 days | Secret and content fields are rejected before logging; deletion completes within 24 hours |
| Share-view telemetry | Disabled by default | 7, 30, or 90 days after explicit owner enablement | Store coarse time/referrer class only, never raw token, password, full IP, or viewer fingerprint; purge within 24 hours |
| Superseded local drafts | 30 days after supersession | 0, 7, or 30 days | Purge on logout/account switch immediately when not actively synced; quota failure never deletes the only copy |
| Encrypted backups | Rolling 30 days | Operator may choose 7–90 days and must publish the value | Account deletion creates an immediate restore-suppression marker; all backup copies expire within the configured window |

Credential rotation invalidates prior key versions immediately for new use.
Account deletion revokes sessions and shares immediately, suppresses restore
immediately, purges live/search/projection data within 24 hours, and completes
encrypted-backup expiry within the configured maximum of 90 days. Restore must
reapply deletion and restore-suppression journals before serving data.
